claim: Re-measure the cumulative dropped-update rate and the longest run of misses after each layer added; assumed spare time is not a budget.

evidence.text: Dropped updates rose from 12.3% to 14.9% as a layer was added, with runs of misses up to 14 updates.
evidence.quote: Gate 0 failures, 0 misses; 14.9 % dropped (12.3 % before), runs to 14. NEX m3d.
